Vinay Gupta (Chief Financial Officer)
Krishna Kant (Chief Compliance Officer)
Anubhav Rajput (Chief Technology Officer) | industry = [[Financial services]], Housing Finance Company (HFC), [[BFSI]] | products = Home Loans, [[Mortgage loan]], Home Improvement Loans, Home Construction Loans, Plot Loans, Home Extension Loans, Land Loans, Loan Against Property, Lease Rental Discounting, [[Fixed Deposits]] | num_locations = 300 branches (2025) | revenue = {{up}} {{INRConvert|7057|c}} (2024) {{Cite web|url=https://www.pnbhousing.com/documents/d/guest/Financial%20Result|title=FY24 Results}} | operating_income = {{up}}{{INRConvert|1954|c}} (2024) | net_income = {{up}} {{INRConvert|1508|c}} (2024) | assets = {{up}} {{INRConvert|72405|c}} (2024) | num_employees = ~1690 (2023) | founded = {{start date|df=yes|1988|11|11}} | hq_location = [[New Delhi]], India | website = {{URL|http://www.pnbhousing.com/}} }} '''PNB Housing Finance Limited''' (PNB Housing) is an Indian housing finance company. It was incorporated in 1988 as a subsidiary of [[Punjab National Bank]] (PNB). The company provides housing loans & loan against property as a part of its product portfolio and also holds the license to accept public deposits. The company's equity shares are listed on [[National Stock Exchange of India]] (NSE) and [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] since November 2016. ==History== PNB Housing Finance was incorporated under the [[Companies Act, 1956]] and commenced its operations on 11 November 1988 as a wholly owned subsidiary of Punjab National Bank (PNB). In 2001, it registered with [[National Housing Bank]] (NHB).{{cite web|author=NULL |url=http://www.nhb.org.in/Regulation/List-granted-Certificate-Registration.pdf |title=List of Housing Finance Companies granted Certificate of Registration |publisher=nhb.org}} On 9 December 2009, PNB entered into a strategic partnership with Destimoney Enterprises Private Limited (DEPL){{cite web|author=Fe Bureau |url=http://archive.financialexpress.com/news/PNB-sells-26-in-housing-finance-arm-to-Destimoney/552124 |title=PNB sells 26% in housing finance arm to Destimoney |date=16 February 2017 |publisher=financialexpress.com}} and sold its 26% stake to DEPL. DEPL which held 49% shares in the company until February 2015 sold its entire shareholding to Quality Investments Holdings, which is owned by Carlyle Group, a global investment firm.{{cite news | url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/finance/carlyle-picks-up-destimoney-s-49-stake-in-pnb-housing-finance-business-standard-news-115022500315_1.html | title=Carlyle picks up Destimoney's 49% stake in PNB Housing Finance | newspaper=Business Standard | first=Manojit | last=Saha | date=25 February 2015 | accessdate=14 September 2020 }} The remaining 51% was owned by the parent bank i.e. [[Punjab National Bank]]. In November 2016, the Company came out with a public issue of equity shares. Its equity shares are listed on National Stock Exchange (NSE) and Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) with effect from 7 November 2016. Post the public issue, the promoters jointly hold 76% of shared in the company and the public shareholding stands at 24%. On 30 March 2019, [[Punjab National Bank]] announced that it had signed an agreement to sell a 13.01% stake in PNB Housing Finance to private equity firm [[General Atlantic]] and alternative investment firm [[Varde Partners]] for {{INRConvert|1851.60|c}}.{{cite web |last1=Panda |first1=Subrata |title=PNB offloads stake in PNB Housing Finance for Rs 1,851 crore |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/finance/pnb-offloads-stake-in-pnb-housing-finance-for-rs-1-851-crore-119032900383_1.html |website=Business Standard India |accessdate=29 March 2019 |date=29 March 2019}}{{cite web |last1=Bureau |first1=Our |title=PNB inks pacts to sell 13% in housing arm for ₹1,852 crore |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/pnb-sells-1301-stake-in-housing-finance-arm-for-185160-cr/article26672761.ece |website=@businessline |date=29 March 2019 |accessdate=29 March 2019 |language=en}} ==References== {{reflist}} {{Financial services in India}} [[Category:Housing finance companies of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies based in New Delhi]] [[Category:The Carlyle Group companies]]
